name: Guoquan Food (Shanghai) Co Ltd
summary: Guoquan Food (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. operates the Guoquan Shihui brand and offers meal solutions for eating at home. Its products include ready-to-eat, heat-and-serve and pre-prepared foods, with an emphasis on hotpot and barbecue ingredients. The catalogue is organised into eight main categories, including hotpot components and barbecue items.
